pairs.english: Mira stood beside him with a bowl of hot soup and three spoons in it. Pavo was protesting that he hadn't drunk any, only tasted one mouthful.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉端着一碗热汤站在他旁边，碗上插着三把勺子，帕沃正在辩解自己没有喝过，只尝了一口。

pairs.target: nài lěi cháo tāmen táitái xiàbā , jiào tǎ wéi kuài qù . tā líkāi lángān shí yòu kàn le yìyǎn nà jǐchù dēng . tāmen háishì nàme yuǎn , kě hēiàn yǐjīng búzài shì yìzhěngkuài méiyǒu fēnbié de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Nerai lifted her chin toward them and told Tavi to go. As he left the railing, he glanced once more at the scattered lights. They were just as far away, but the darkness was no longer one undifferentiated expanse.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾朝他们抬抬下巴，叫塔维快去。他离开栏杆时又看了一眼那几处灯。它们还是那么远，可黑暗已经不再是一整块没有分别的地方。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ yibǎ sháozǐ sāi gěi tā , shuō zàibùlái jiù zhī shèng dòuzǐ . tǎ wéi yǎo le yìsháo , tàngdé xīqì . yīwén zài pángbiān xiào , tā yě gēnzhe xiào , chàdiǎn bǎ tāng sǎ zài gāng xǐ gānjìng de xié shàng .
pairs.english: Mira thrust a spoon at him, saying another moment and only beans would remain. Tavi scooped a spoonful and gasped at the heat. Iven laughed beside him; he laughed too, nearly spilling soup on his freshly washed shoes.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把一把勺子塞给他，说再不来就只剩豆子。塔维舀了一勺，烫得吸气。伊文在旁边笑，他也跟着笑，差点把汤洒在刚洗干净的鞋上。
